provenance.source_scope: runtime source tree; imported/exported resources may omit original files

seed.note: procedural shaders use fixed analytic noise; no RNG

metadata.aircraft_input_hash_convention: sha256 of exact aircraft input file bytes
metadata.aircraft_semantic_hash_convention: sha256 of Godot JSON.stringify(parsed_input, indent=empty, sort_keys=true, full_precision=false); not file bytes
metadata.frames: world NED (north, east, down); body FRD (forward, right, down); quaternion body->NED [w,x,y,z]
metadata.ground: flat at 0 m; 3 spring-damper gear contacts (E1) with tyre friction and nose-wheel steering, brakes off (E2), stiction anchors (E3b1), on field 'default' surfaces (E3a)
metadata.loads: Fx..Mz: body-axis loads excluding gravity; tick 0 evaluates reset state/aux; tick k>0 evaluates state k-1 with aux k (after pre_step)
metadata.scenario: runway threshold on field 'default' (idle engine, static equilibrium; experimental)
metadata.state_timing: state and aux at tick k; aux advances before RK4 and is held through its stages; cmd_* drives that step (reset commands at tick 0)
